{"body":"## Summary

Implemented a comprehensive mobile-first experience by intelligently merging Nick's mobile optimizations with existing advanced functionality. Focused on progressive disclosure and thumb-friendly UX that scales gracefully from mobile to desktop.

## Key Mobile-First Improvements

### 🎯 Smart View Defaults
- Auto card view (comfortable) on screens < 640px for better touch experience
- Preserved desktop preferences and advanced functionality
- Responsive breakpoint strategy: mobile-first with progressive enhancement

### 📱 Mobile-Optimized Filtering & Navigation  
- **Mobile**: Expandable category grid with 44px+ touch targets
- **Desktop**: Category dropdown with counts + inline stats display
- Progressive disclosure: show complexity where screen real estate allows
- Native HTML selects for better mobile performance

### 📋 Responsive Table Design
- Hidden redundant columns on mobile (Category, Weight, Qty, Properties)
- Key info displayed inline under item names: `Category • Weight • Worn • Consumable`
- Clean mobile layout: Item name + Actions only
- Full feature set preserved on desktop

### 🎨 Visual Polish & Consistency
- Mountain icon: perfect square with centered alignment
- Profile icon visible on mobile next to logout  
- Floating action button constrained to content width (not viewport edge)
- Consistent 44px minimum touch targets throughout interface

## Technical Implementation

### Information Architecture Patterns
- **Mobile**: Vertical stack → Expandable sections → Inline secondary info
- **Desktop**: Horizontal layout → Persistent controls → Separate columns
- Smart responsive breakpoints (sm: 640px, md: 768px, lg: 1024px)

### Component Enhancements
- Native select elements over custom dropdowns on mobile
- Responsive image heights (h-32 sm:h-48) in cards
- Progressive form layouts with increased touch-friendly spacing
- Smart column hiding with inline information display

### Advanced Features Preserved  
- ✅ Import functionality (LighterPack integration)
- ✅ Advanced form components (MobileFormDrawer, wrappers)
- ✅ Category filtering with counts
- ✅ All existing functionality maintained

## Design Guidelines Added

Added comprehensive mobile-first design guidelines to `CLAUDE.md` for future development:
- Progressive disclosure philosophy
- Touch target standards (44px minimum)
- Responsive breakpoint strategies  
- Component-specific mobile patterns
- Visual consistency standards

- [x] Desktop experience: All advanced features, layout consistency
- [x] Responsive breakpoints: Smooth transitions between layouts
- [x] Touch targets: All interactive elements meet 44px minimum
- [x] Build process: TypeScript compilation successful
- [x] Progressive enhancement: Features appear appropriately at each breakpoint

## Result

True mobile-first experience that **"works on mobile™"** while preserving all advanced desktop functionality. Users get intuitive touch-friendly interactions on mobile and full feature richness on desktop.
